title: Re-evaluating the need for Modelling Term-Dependence in Text Classification Problems
reasoning: The paper focuses on comparing the technical performance of term-dependence models against independence models in text classification. While it uses the 20-Newsgroups dataset which contains a category for religion (soc.religion.christian), the study does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as its objective; it treats it simply as a classification label.
